watches.name: Baagh IV
watches.description: The Baagh IV runs on a Miyota 8315 Automatic movement, offering a 60-hour power reserve and an intricate disc mechanism. Its rotor features a walking tiger, adding a distinctive touch to the watch’s mechanical artistry. Crafted in 43mm stainless steel, the watch incorporates a rare Quarter Rupee Coin from 1946, bearing the iconic walking Baagh. Minted in very limited quantities, these coins were exceptionally difficult to source, making their incorporation into the collection even more significant. The walking tiger bears a close resemblance to the Make in India logo, while the coin itself holds historical significance as one of the last coin issues of the British Rule in India. Available in golden and steel case variants, the watch features a sapphire crystal with internal anti-reflective (AR) coating, a see-through case back, and water resistance up to 5 ATM. SPECIFICATION Case 43 MM Case Material 316L Stainless Steel Dial Certified British India Quarter Rupee Coin (1946) Movement Miyota 8315 Automatic Crystal Front and Back Sapphire Power Reserve 60 Hours Strap 22mm Genuine Leather Strap Water Resistance 5 ATM

watches.name: AKSHA WOOD FLIP WATCH
watches.description: The Aksha takes its name from one of the foundational languages of India’s civilisational heritage: Sanskrit. AKSHA ( अक्ष ) means axis, a fitting name for a timepiece built around a distinctive rotating case and its defining vertical pivot. An evolution of the much-loved Rajasthan Polo Flip Watch, the Aksha draws inspiration from the regal heritage of polo, translating the sport’s distinctive balance of strength, precision and grace into a refined contemporary dress watch. At just 7.60 mm, its signature rectangular case gives the timepiece a commanding presence on the wrist, while its considered proportions lend an effortless sense of elegance and versatility. The design reflects the spirit of polo; bringing together the robustness demanded by the sport with the sophistication of its aristocratic tradition. Aksha features an ingenious pivot mechanism. Built around a vertical axis, the case rotates smoothly within its frame, allowing the wearer to turn the watch and reveal its other side. Beyond its visual intrigue, the mechanism adds a sense of robustness and functionality, while protecting the watch’s dial when it is turned inward. The interplay of the axis, pivot and rotating case is what gives the Aksha its distinctive character. The Aksha is also designed to become uniquely yours! Once the case is rotated, a stainless-steel surface is revealed; a blank canvas waiting to be personalised. Whether it is a meaningful symbol, a personal message, an artwork or something entirely individual, the reverse of the Aksha offers the wearer an opportunity to create something that belongs exclusively to them. It transforms the watch from a timepiece into a personal statement; something to turn, reveal and cherish. Each variant of the Aksha features a richly textured dial crafted from carefully selected natural materials. Available in Mother of Pearl, Wood, Black Marble, Green Marble and Abalone, every variation carries its own natural grain, texture and character, making each dial subtly unique. Adding a distinctly Indian character to the refined dress-watch aesthetic, the dial features Devanagari numerals at 12, 3, 6 and 9 o’clock; a considered detail that connects contemporary watchmaking with India’s visual and cultural heritage. The Aksha is a celebration of contrasts: Strength and Finesse, Tradition and Contemporary design, Performance and Elegance. A timepiece shaped by the spirit of polo, defined by its ingenious axis, and rooted in the visual heritage of India. SPECIFICATION Case 316L Grade Stainless Steel Dial Wood Dial Size 45x30mm Thickness 7.60mm Crystal Sapphire Movement Miyota 9T25 Slim Strap 22mm Genuine Leather Strap

watches.name: The Rare Earth Jump Hour Watch
watches.description: A masterclass in multi-layered depth and ornamental design, Jaipur Watch Company proudly unveils its creation - “ The Rare Earth Collection ” Automatic Watch that seamlessly bridges the gap between raw natural beauty and regal craftsmanship. Built around a striking ornate tonneau silhouette, this timepiece transforms the wrist into a canvas for the earth's most captivating geological wonders. The defining characteristic of each timepiece is its vibrant semi-precious gemstone dial. Precision-cut to showcase its natural, unaltered beauty. The dial is available in four distinct stone - Malachite, Tiger’s Eye, Lapis Lazuli and Aventurine. Because no two gemstone matrices are ever identical, every watch in this collection is an absolute one-of-a-kind wearable art piece. Features a deeply recessed, continuous border of intricate filigree-style scrollwork, adding a tactile, baroque texture that frames the gemstone backdrop. The dial itself is a masterclass in multi-layered depth. A central guilloché-textured black disc displays the minutes with a uniquely curved fluid hand, while a specialized jumping Hour window sits prominently at the 12 o’clock position. Balanced perfectly at the 6 o'clock position, a specially designed rotating disk acts as a sub-second complication. This monochromatic disk sweeps smoothly through a dedicated window, adding a hypnotic kinetic rhythm to the dial layout. Completing the timepiece is a premium alligator-embossed genuine leather strap, meticulously color-matched to complement the deep organic tones of the underlying gemstone. The watch is fitted with scratch-resistant sapphire crystal to ensure the intricate dial elements and stones are preserved in pristine clarity for generations. Also a transparent peephole case back powered by automatic movement, offering a 42-hour power reserve — a reliable engine that ensures your timepiece keeps ticking with grace. SPECIFICATION Case 316L Grade Stainless Steel Dial (Malachite Stone, Tiger’s Eye stone. Aventurine Stone, Lapis Lazuli Stone) with guilloché centre Complication Jumping Hour Size 41mm X 30mm Thickness 10.5mm Crystal Sapphire Strap 20mm Leather Back Peep-Hole Glass Back Water Resistance 5 ATM

specsRaw.Dial: (Malachite Stone, Tiger’s Eye stone. Aventurine Stone, Lapis Lazuli Stone) with guilloché centre

watches.description: A timeless expression of individuality, this exquisite ring watch reimagines the art of horology in a form designed to be worn close. Handcrafted in Jaipur, its distinctive silhouette brings together the elegance of fine jewellery and the precision of watchmaking. Encased in polished 316L stainless steel with rhinestone embellishments, the compact timepiece is complimented by an elastic ring band in refined stainless-steel making it size friendly. watches.name: FILIGREE V BLACK
watches.description: Filigree Technique Filigree is a meticulous and intricate jewelry-making technique, where skilled artisans delicately solder fine, flexible threads of precious metal, which are then twisted or curled into elegant, artistic motifs. This method, used for centuries, creates stunning designs such as scrollwork, lacy patterns, symmetrical Art Deco styles, and other captivating forms. In this case, the technique is applied to the Filigree Wristwear collection, which incorporates the King George VI - 1 Anna Coin from British India (minted between 1942-1945), adding historical significance to its exquisite craftsmanship. The 1 Anna coin, a symbol of the colonial era, enhances the collection’s uniqueness and timeless appeal. Following the complete sell-out of the original Filigree Wristwear collection, Jaipur Watch Company is proud to present the Filigree V Wristwear . This new edition offers updated colors, dimensions, and movement, continuing the legacy of fine artistry while introducing a fresh design. SPECIFICATION Case 316 L Grade Stainless Steel Case Diameter 38mm Thickness 10.5mm Crystal Sapphire Crystal Movement Miyota 2026 Quartz Strap 18mm Metal Bracelet Water Resistant 3ATM

watches.description: Filigree Technique Filigree is a meticulous and intricate jewelry-making technique, where skilled artisans delicately solder fine, flexible threads of precious metal, which are then twisted or curled into elegant, artistic motifs. This method, used for centuries, creates stunning designs such as scrollwork, lacy patterns, symmetrical Art Deco styles, and other captivating forms. In this case, the technique is applied to the Filigree Wristwear collection, which incorporates the King George VI - 1 Anna Coin from British India (minted between 1942-1945), adding historical significance to its exquisite craftsmanship. The 1 Anna coin, a symbol of the colonial era, enhances the collection’s uniqueness and timeless appeal. Following the complete sell-out of the original Filigree Wristwear collection, Jaipur Watch Company is proud to present the Filigree V Wristwear . This new edition offers updated colors, dimensions, and movement, continuing the legacy of fine artistry while introducing a fresh design. SPECIFICATION Case 316 L Grade Stainless Steel Case Diameter 38mm Thickness 10.5mm Crystal Sapphire Crystal Movement Miyota 2026 Quartz Strap 18mm Metal Bracelet Water Resistant 3ATM

watches.name: Kings Wristwear IV
watches.description: A celebration of India's numismatic heritage and contemporary watchmaking, this timepiece places an authentic One Naya Paisa coin at the heart of its design. Suspended within an innovative floating architecture, the coin remains the visual centerpiece while a unique minute hand and rotating hour disc glide seamlessly around it, creating a captivating display of time unlike any conventional watch. Crafted from stainless steel, the rounded-square case features finely brushed surfaces contrasted by polished edges, giving it a refined architectural presence. Measuring 42 mm, the case strikes a balanced proportion on the wrist while showcasing the intricate moving disc mechanism beneath a scratch-resistant sapphire crystal. Powering the watch is the reliable Miyota 8215 automatic movement, chosen for its proven performance and everyday dependability. An exhibition caseback reveals the mechanical movement in action. (Note: The Coin on the dial can be of any year between 1957-1963) SPECIFICATION Case Material Stainless Steel Case OD 42mm Crystal Sapphire Dial 1 Naya Paisa Coin Movement Miyota 8215 Caseback Exhibition Caseback Strap 22mm Genuine leather

watches.name: GATES OF INDIA - GATEWAY OF INDIA | LEHERIYA
watches.description: At the heart of Jaipur's City Palace stand its most celebrated entrances, the Lotus Gate/the Leheriya Gate of Pritam Niwas Chowk. More than architectural masterpieces, these gateways symbolize prosperity, renewal, and the changing seasons, welcoming generations into the royal world of art, culture, and tradition. Inspired by these iconic palace gates, Jaipur Watch Company reimagines the idea of a gateway as a passage through India's remarkable heritage. Its unique flip mechanism reveals some of the nation's most celebrated heritage landmarks, including the Gateway of India, India Gate, Red Fort, and Charminar, each representing a remarkable chapter of India's architectural and cultural legacy. Uniting royal symbolism with national heritage, this timepiece is a tribute to the gateways that have witnessed history, welcomed generations, and continued to tell India's story through every turn. THE FLIP CASE The Flip Dial Mechanism transforms the way you experience time. With a smooth 360° rotation. It offers a refined dual-display design that reflects exceptional engineering and meticulous craftsmanship. Water Resistance 5 ATM Weight 70gm Strap Genuine Leather Semi- Gloss - 20mm Edition GATES OF INDIA Crafted Jaipur, India | 7 weeks per piece Lead Time Delivery period will be intimated by email. Warranty 2 years international · Lifetime servicing in Jaipur

watches.name: FILIGREE V GREEN
watches.description: Filigree Technique Filigree is a meticulous and intricate jewelry-making technique, where skilled artisans delicately solder fine, flexible threads of precious metal, which are then twisted or curled into elegant, artistic motifs. This method, used for centuries, creates stunning designs such as scrollwork, lacy patterns, symmetrical Art Deco styles, and other captivating forms. In this case, the technique is applied to the Filigree Wristwear collection, which incorporates the King George VI - 1 Anna Coin from British India (minted between 1942-1945), adding historical significance to its exquisite craftsmanship. The 1 Anna coin, a symbol of the colonial era, enhances the collection’s uniqueness and timeless appeal. Following the complete sell-out of the original Filigree Wristwear collection, Jaipur Watch Company is proud to present the Filigree V Wristwear . This new edition offers updated colors, dimensions, and movement, continuing the legacy of fine artistry while introducing a fresh design. SPECIFICATION Case 316 L Grade Stainless Steel Case Diameter 38mm Thickness 10.5mm Crystal Sapphire Crystal Movement Miyota 2026 Quartz Strap 18mm Leather Strap Water Resistant 3ATM

watches.name: THE PICE HERITAGE
watches.description: The Pice Heritage Watch by Jaipur Watch Company is a distinctive luxury timepiece that blends history, craftsmanship, and modern design. At its core, it features a genuine ‘One-Pice coin (1950–1955)’, seated on a dial inspired by India's traditional hand-hammered brass craft, offering a unique and artistic texture. The dial also showcases Devanagari script numerals, adding an extra layer of historical and cultural significance to the timepiece. Designed to cater to both men and women, the 40mm case size ensures the watch appeals to a wide audience. The inclusion of movable lugs enhances comfort and adaptability, allowing the watch to fit a variety of wrist sizes while adding a premium vintage touch to its overall look. This thoughtful blend of modern functionality and classic design elements reflects Jaipur Watch Company’s commitment to creating versatile yet luxurious timepieces that celebrate Indian tradition. Crafted from premium materials like stainless steel and Mineral glass, The Pice Heritage Coin Watch offers durability and elegance. Each timepiece not only serves as a functional watch but also as a wearable piece of history and art. (Note: The Coin on the dial can be of any year between 1950-1955) SPECIFICATION Case OD 40 mm Crystal Mineral Dial One Pice (1950 -1955), White Hammered Texture, Devanagari Numerals Movement Miyota 2033 Quartz Strap 20mm Genuine Leather

watches.name: Swami Vivekananda Automatic Watch
watches.description: Inspired by Swami Vivekananda’s timeless benediction to Sister Nivedita, this watch preserves a remarkable piece of history on its dial—a faithful recreation of the handwritten manuscript of Blessings to Nivedita, composed around 1900. More than a poem, it was a profound spiritual charge that entrusted Nivedita with a mission to serve, educate, and uplift India. Set against a vintage parchment-toned dial, complemented by a classic gold-finished case and rich brown leather strap, the timepiece embodies wisdom, courage, devotion, and selfless service. Each glance at the dial is a reminder of Vivekananda’s enduring vision and the transformative power of purpose-driven lives. SPECIFICATION Case OD 39mm Crystal Sapphire Dial Recreation of an actual historic letter. Movement Miyota 8215 Automatic Case Thickness 15mm Case Material 316L Stainless Steel Case back Peephole Water resistance 5ATM Strap 18mm Genuine Leather & adjustable metal mesh bracelet

watches.name: The Rare Earth Jump Hour Watch
watches.description: A masterclass in multi-layered depth and ornamental design, Jaipur Watch Company proudly unveils its creation - “ The Rare Earth Collection ” Automatic Watch that seamlessly bridges the gap between raw natural beauty and regal craftsmanship. Built around a striking ornate tonneau silhouette, this timepiece transforms the wrist into a canvas for the earth's most captivating geological wonders. The defining characteristic of each timepiece is its vibrant semi-precious gemstone dial. Precision-cut to showcase its natural, unaltered beauty. The dial is available in four distinct stone - Malachite, Tiger’s Eye, Lapis Lazuli and Aventurine. Because no two gemstone matrices are ever identical, every watch in this collection is an absolute one-of-a-kind wearable art piece. Features a deeply recessed, continuous border of intricate filigree-style scrollwork, adding a tactile, baroque texture that frames the gemstone backdrop. The dial itself is a masterclass in multi-layered depth. A central guilloché-textured black disc displays the minutes with a uniquely curved fluid hand, while a specialized jumping Hour window sits prominently at the 12 o’clock position. Balanced perfectly at the 6 o'clock position, a specially designed rotating disk acts as a sub-second complication. This monochromatic disk sweeps smoothly through a dedicated window, adding a hypnotic kinetic rhythm to the dial layout. Completing the timepiece is a premium alligator-embossed genuine leather strap, meticulously color-matched to complement the deep organic tones of the underlying gemstone. The watch is fitted with scratch-resistant sapphire crystal to ensure the intricate dial elements and stones are preserved in pristine clarity for generations. Also a transparent peephole case back powered by automatic movement, offering a 42-hour power reserve — a reliable engine that ensures your timepiece keeps ticking with grace. SPECIFICATION Case 316L Grade Stainless Steel Dial (Malachite Stone, Tiger’s Eye stone. Aventurine Stone, Lapis Lazuli Stone) with guilloché centre Complication Jumping Hour Size 41mm X 30mm Thickness 10.5mm Crystal Sapphire Strap 20mm Leather Back Peep-Hole Glass Back Water Resistance 5 ATM

Crafted from solid wood and adorned with elegant brass accents, it evokes the grandeur of vintage design while offering modern reliability with a precise quartz movement. At its crown sits Jaipur Watch Company’s iconic Baagh (Tiger) , symbolizing strength, heritage, and regality. This versatile piece serves a dual purpose — it can be admired as a distinguished decorative artifact when closed, or used as a functional clock when opened. With its rich vintage appeal and artisanal detailing, the Heritage Clock is thoughtfully designed to complement royal-inspired interiors , making it a collector’s delight and a conversation piece that carries the legacy of time forward. watches.name: DEVANAGARI BAAGH GOLD PLATED
watches.description: The "Baagh Collection" runs on a Miyota 8215 Automatic movement. The collection is available in 4 variants: golden and silver colored cases with Roman and Devanagari numerals. The watch has a sapphire crystal with AR coating on the inside and a see-through back. The Watch is water resistant upto 5 ATM. This 43mm stainless steel watch has been created by using a particular One Rupee Coin from the year 1947, bearing a Tiger on the face. The Walking tiger (Baagh in Hindi) has a close resemblance to the Make In India Logo. This One Rupee Coin holds its significance as it was the last coin minted under the British Rule. It was minted only in the years 1946 (second half) and 1947. watches.name: Imperial I 2013 Re-Issue
watches.description: The Imperial 2013 Re-Issue revives Jaipur Watch Company’s iconic Imperial I , reintroduced due to exceptional demand even after its original limited edition sold out. This upgraded edition transitions from quartz to automatic movement , embracing the essence of traditional watchmaking. Housed in a refined 37 mm case with an 18 mm lug width , the timepiece is powered by the Miyota 8215 automatic calibre with a 42-hour power reserve . The dial features an authentic King George VI One Rupee silver coin , preserving a piece of history in every watch. An exhibition case back reveals the mechanical movement within, completing a timepiece that seamlessly blends heritage, craftsmanship, and modern horology. watches.name: IMPERIAL V AUTOMATIC WRISTWEAR
watches.description: The Fifth extension to one of its bestselling timepieces, The Imperial Collection, Jaipur Watch Company, introduces the Imperial V Wristwear. An antique coin as a watch dial is an absolutely mesmerising concept. Imperial V Automatic Wristwear has been ingeniously designed with a King George VI (1938-45 era) Half Rupee Silver Coin with Rice Grain Guilloche around it, which is a 5-century old craft. It comes with 3 finishes: Gold, Stainless steel and Rose gold with 4 coloured dial options. The vintage coin is placed inside a specially created color dial with raised metal indices. Completely donned in sapphire (domed sapphire in front and sapphire glass behind), this 42 mm size watch ticks on an 8215 Automatic Movement from Miyota. The Bezel of the watch resembles the traditional Indian design. This entire range of watches is water-resistant and can resist water up to a depth of 50 meters (5 ATM). Available in classic and fresh colours - Eclipse Black, Forest Green, Mint Cyan, Salmon Pink, made with genuine leather and Metal Bracelet with a pleasing butterfly clasp. SPECIFICATION Case 42mm Dial Certified King George VI Half Rupee Coin (1938-1945) Back Exhibition Case Back Thickness 14mm Crystal Front and Back Sapphire Movement Japanese Miyota 8215 Automatic Strap 20mm Metal Bracelet Coating AR Coating Water Resistance 5ATM Case Material 316L Stainless Steel

watches.name: STAMP WATCH AUTOMATIC
watches.description: King George VI has been a defining muse for Jaipur Watch Company since its inception. Continuing this legacy, the Stamp Watch Automatic Edition brings history to life through an authentic paper postal stamp dating from 1937–1947 , preserved as the dial of the timepiece—an approach rarely attempted in global watchmaking. This new edition marks a significant evolution with the introduction of a premium Miyota 6T28 automatic movement , replacing the earlier Swiss quartz calibre and embracing the true spirit of traditional horology. Each dial features a genuine vintage stamp in denominations ranging from 3 Pies to 12 Anna , making every watch unique. Produced in strictly limited numbers , the Stamp Watch Automatic Edition is a living artifact—where heritage, craftsmanship, and mechanical excellence move in perfect harmony. SPECIFICATION Case 316 L Grade Stainless Steel Dial King George VI Stamp, Princely State of Nabha, Green Denomination 9 Pice Size 34 X 30.3 MM Thickness 11MM Crystal Sapphire Movement Miyota 6T28 Automatic Strap Leather

watches.name: Jumping Hour Watch - Blue 40mm
watches.description: Jaipur Watch Company, India’s only bespoke watch manufacturer unveils its latest limited edition watch in its Harmony Collection—the ‘Jumping Hour Watch’, a unique timepiece that has a “hour window” instead of the “hour hand”! Unlike the traditional watch, where the hour hand sweeps the dial, this distinctive creation has a disc behind a tiny window on the dial that ‘jumps’ to indicate the hour accurately when the minute hand touches 12 (60 minutes). This royal blue heirloom has an enamelled blue dial, with the hour window placed right at the top. It has one long hand that sweeps the dial indicating the minutes and a sub dial displaying a tiny second hand. This mechanism is based on a modified automatic movement, with a power reserve of 42 hours. Part of the complexity of creating a jump hour movement is the regulation of power that is transferred to the hour disc. This elegant timepiece with a steel case, chrome finish, special lugs and a 'quick-release' strap is available in a Jaipur Watch Company Signature Case with a unique embossed back. Size: 40mm SPECIFICATION Back Cover Embossed Back Bezel Inspired with hand-crafted design Case OD 40mm 316L Steel Crown Stainless Steel Crystal Sapphire Dial Curved enameled blue dial with hour window Features Recessed subdial, Special floating lugs Movement TY 2709 (Modified) Power Reserve 42 Hours Serial Number Marked to 100 Units Strap 18mm Water Resistance 5 ATM

watches.name: Pendant Watch
watches.description: Necklace watches are so uncommon these days that it’s hard to imagine that they were the original watches. The precursor to the pocket watch was a clunky but luxurious 16th-century timepiece — more reliable in impressing the royal courts of Europe than clocking the exact time — that dangled on a chain around the necks of only the very wealthy. The first such watch was invented in 1510. This model was much smaller than any other timepiece and was compact enough to be worn. However, it was not yet worn inside the pocket at this time, but rather as a pendant on a chain around the neck. Add a touch of class to any look with the stunning pendant watches by Jaipur Watch Company. A ladies pendant watch makes a lovely, understated alternative to the traditional pocket watch, with a smaller, more demure design that is flattering while making an elegant impression. A pendant watch is ideally suited to be worn around the neck in a necklace style. Jaipur Watch Company is known to make wristwatches with coins from the period of King George VI, the last Emperor of British India. The dial of this exquisite Pendant Watch is made out of an actual Postal Stationery Envelope featuring One and a Half Anna postal stamp value from the British India era. The body of this neckwear is made out of sterling silver, having a Victorian style of design using enamel artwork. Enamelwork is a technique of decoration where metal objects or surfaces are given a vitreous glaze that is fused onto the surface by intense heat to create a brilliantly colored decorative effect. It is an art form noted for its brilliant, glossy surface, which is hard and long-lasting. NOTE: The chain is NOT included with the Pendant Watch.

Crafted with meticulous attention to detail, the Tonneau Case serves as a captivating showcase for both the exquisite coin and the beautifully enameled dial. Its distinctive stepped rails gracefully complement the tonneau case, creating an interplay of light and shadow that ensures The Baagh II stands out effortlessly in any setting, making it a true statement piece for the discerning connoisseur. The offset watch face ingeniously highlights the singular presentation of the coin, adding a touch of sophistication to its aesthetic appeal. Crafted with meticulous attention to detail, the Tonneau Case serves as a captivating showcase for both the exquisite coin and the beautifully enameled dial. Its distinctive stepped rails gracefully complement the tonneau case, creating an interplay of light and shadow that ensures The Baagh II stands out effortlessly in any setting, making it a true statement piece for the discerning connoisseur. watches.name: THE ETERNAL WATCH
watches.description: The Jaipur Watch Company proudly presents the Eternal Watch, a timepiece that not only tells time but also tells a story of India's rich history. This exquisite watch features a genuine One Pice coin from 1950-55, the first coin minted in independent India, seamlessly integrated into its design. The One Pice coin, with its iconic depiction of a galloping horse, symbolizes India's leap into independence and the dawn of a new era. It represents the strength, freedom, and progress that defined the nation during its early years of sovereignty. This historical coin, encased within the watch, serves as a poignant reminder of India's journey and its enduring legacy. The watch face is adorned with a mother-of-pearl dial, adding an element of elegance and sophistication. The luminous quality of the mother-of-pearl complements the vintage charm of the One Pice coin, creating a harmonious blend of history and artistry. The sleek, silver-tone case and black leather strap enhance its timeless appeal, making it a versatile accessory for any occasion. Crafted with meticulous attention to detail, the Eternal Watch is a tribute to the craftsmanship and heritage of Jaipur. Each timepiece is a reflection of the city's renowned artistry, blending traditional design with contemporary elegance. The watch not only honors India's past but also celebrates the skill and dedication of the artisans who bring this piece of history to life. Wearing the Eternal Watch is more than a fashion statement; it is a connection to India's rich heritage and a celebration of its journey towards freedom and progress. This watch is a perfect gift for history enthusiasts, collectors, and anyone who cherishes the legacy of India. With every glance at the time, one is reminded of the resilience and spirit that define the Indian identity. The Jaipur Watch Company invites you to own a piece of history with the Eternal Watch, a timeless treasure that embodies the essence of India's storied past and its vibrant present. (Note: The Coin on the dial can be of any year between 1950-1955) SPECIFICATION Case 316 L Grade Stainless Steel Dial Blue MOP Size 42mm Thickness 14mm Crystal Sapphire Movement TMI NH35A Automatic Strap 20mm Leather strap

specsRaw.Dial: Blue MOP

watches.name: RAJASTHAN POLO WATCH LAPIS LAZULI
watches.description: The Rajasthan Polo Watch: A Timeless Symbol of Sophistication and Durability The Rajasthan Polo Watch stands out as a symbol of distinction in the world of fine timepieces, celebrated for its unique design and enduring elegance. Its iconic rectangular case makes a bold statement, combining strength with refined aesthetics. The dial, crafted from semi-precious stones, adds a layer of sophistication, exuding an air of understated luxury. Inspired by the regal sport of polo—where both horse and rider display power and grace through their skillful maneuvers—this watch captures the same spirit. It's a dress watch that balances robustness with elegance. The collection features four exceptional models, each showcasing dials made from Tiger's Eye, Malachite, Lapis Lazuli, and Aventurine, each stone lending its own unique character to the piece. Each variant is limited to 75 pieces. One of the most intriguing aspects of this dual-sided watch is its ability to rotate within its case, protecting the dial and offering a unique form of personalization. This pivot mechanism, operating on a vertical axis, allows the wearer to switch between faces, making it a highly versatile accessory. Housed within a 40mm x 30mm rectangular case made from 316L stainless steel, and powered by the dependable Miyota 2025 movement, the Rajasthan Polo Watch is more than just a timekeeping device—it's a statement of luxury and style. The stone dials, with their natural beauty, only enhance its appeal, making this timepiece a true icon of elegance. SPECIFICATION Case 316 L Grade Stainless Steel Dial Lapis Lazuli Stone Size 40 x 30 mm Thickness 9 mm Crystal Sapphire Movement Miyota 2025 Strap 22mm Genuine Leather strap Limited Pieces 75

Building upon the legacy of its predecessor, The Baagh II proudly features the distinctive Quarter Rupee Bagh Coin, a symbol of heritage and tradition. Drawing inspiration from the opulent Art Deco era, the design of The Baagh II intricately showcases a mesmerizing Mosaic enameled dial, available in three captivating color variations. The offset watch face ingeniously highlights the singular presentation of the coin, adding a touch of sophistication to its aesthetic appeal. At the heart of this masterpiece lies a premium Small Automatic Miyota Movement, renowned for its precision and reliability, offering a remarkable 42 hours of power reserve. The introduction of the unique Tonneau case marks a significant milestone in Jaipur Watch Company's esteemed collection. Crafted with meticulous attention to detail, the Tonneau Case serves as a captivating showcase for both the exquisite coin and the beautifully enameled dial. Its distinctive stepped rails gracefully complement the tonneau case, creating an interplay of light and shadow that ensures The Baagh II stands out effortlessly in any setting, making it a true statement piece for the discerning connoisseur. This stainless steel watch has been created by using a particular Quarter Rupee Coin from the year 1947, bearing a Tiger on the face. The Walking tiger (Baagh in Hindi) has close resemblance with the Make In India Logo. This Quarter Rupee Coin holds its significance as it was the last coin minted under the British Rule. It was minted only in the years 1946 (second half) and 1947. SPECIFICATION Case OD 43mm x 34mm Dial Enamelled Dial Movement Miyota 6T28 Premium Automatic Crystal Sapphire Case Material 316L Stainless Steel, Studded with VVS natural Diamonds Power Reserve 40 Hours Strap 18mm Black Leather Strap Water Resistance 5 ATM

watches.name: IMPERIAL IV AUTOMATIC WRISTWEAR
watches.description: The fourth extension to one of its bestselling timepieces, The Imperial Collection, Jaipur Watch Company introduces the Imperial IV Wristwear. An antique coin as a watch dial is an absolutely mesmerizing concept. Jaipur Watch Company’s Imperial IV Automatic Wristwear has been ingeniously designed with a King George VI (1938-45 era) Half Rupee Silver Coin with intricate designs around it from the British era as its dial. A limited edition serial-numbered stainless steel watch, it comes with 3 Color options and 12 variants. The vintage coin is placed inside a specially created color dial with raised metal indices. Completely donned in sapphire (domed sapphire in front and sapphire glass behind), this 42 mm size watch ticks on an Automatic Movement from Miyota Citizen. The Bezel of the watch resembles the traditional Indian design. This entire range of watches is water resistant and can resist water up to a depth of 50 meters (5 ATM). Available in classic colors - Eclipse Black, Royal Blue and Forest Green, the strap is made with genuine leather with a pleasing butterfly clasp. SPECIFICATION Case 42mm Dial Certified King George VI Hlf Rupee Coin (1938-1945) Back Exhibition Case Back Thickness 12mm Crystal Front and Back Sapphire Movement Japanese Miyota 8215 Automatic Strap 20mm Leather strap with Butterfly clasp Coating AR Coating Water Resistance 5ATM Case thickness 12mm Case Material 316L Stainless Steel

specsRaw.Dial: Certified King George VI Hlf Rupee Coin (1938-1945)

watches.name: THE ETERNAL AVENTURINE WRISTWEAR
watches.description: The Jaipur Watch Company proudly presents the One Pice Heritage Watch, a timepiece that not only tells time but also tells a story of India's rich history. This exquisite watch features a genuine One Pice coin from 1950-55, the first coin minted in independent India, seamlessly integrated into its design. The One Pice coin, with its iconic depiction of a galloping horse, symbolizes India's leap into independence and the dawn of a new era. It represents the strength, freedom, and progress that defined the nation during its early years of sovereignty. This historical coin, encased within the watch, serves as a poignant reminder of India's journey and its enduring legacy. The watch face is adorned with a never used before Opal stone and Aventurine Stone Dial and Black mother-of-pearl dial, adding an element of elegance and sophistication. The luminous quality of the mother-of-pearl complements the vintage charm of the One Pice coin, creating a harmonious blend of history and artistry. The sleek, silver-tone case and black leather strap enhance its timeless appeal, making it a versatile accessory for any occasion. Crafted with meticulous attention to detail, the One Pice Heritage Watch is a tribute to the craftsmanship and heritage of Jaipur. Each timepiece is a reflection of the city's renowned artistry, blending traditional design with contemporary elegance. The watch not only honors India's past but also celebrates the skill and dedication of the artisans who bring this piece of history to life. Wearing the One Pice Heritage Watch is more than a fashion statement; it is a connection to India's rich heritage and a celebration of its journey towards freedom and progress. This watch is a perfect gift for history enthusiasts, collectors, and anyone who cherishes the legacy of India. With every glance at the time, one is reminded of the resilience and spirit that define the Indian identity. The Jaipur Watch Company invites you to own a piece of history with the One Pice Heritage Watch, a timeless treasure that embodies the essence of India's storied past and its vibrant present. (Note: The Coin on the dial can be of any year between 1950-1955) SPECIFICATION Case 316 L Grade Stainless Steel Dial Aventurine Size 42mm Thickness 14mm Crystal Sapphire Movement TMI NH35A Automatic Strap 20mm Leather strap

specsRaw.Dial: Aventurine

watches.name: THE ROYAL BAAGH
watches.description: In every great civilization, the tiger (the Baagh) has stood as a guardian of the wild and a sovereign of the land. The Royal Baagh Collection channels this enduring symbol of strength into a timepiece that is as commanding as it is refined—built for those who carry a sense of purpose, presence, and pride. This collection is a tribute to legacy—an homage to the iconic Baagh timepiece that has become one of our most celebrated creations. Royal Baagh evolves that spirit, pushing the boundaries of craftsmanship and detail while honoring the soul of the original. Each case is CNC-carved individually, sculpted with singular focus to ensure every edge, curve, and engraving receives the care it deserves. The case and lugs are enveloped in exquisite macro 3D reliefs—a prowling Baagh brought to life, surrounded by intricate floral motifs inspired by India’s royal courts and classical design. At the center of the watch, a traditional floral dial pattern blooms with elegance. Subtle innovation adds movement: a rotating date disc, tracked by a sharp red triangle, encircles the dial—merging storytelling with function. Shielded by sapphire crystal, the Royal Baagh is built to endure—just like the legacy it celebrates. SPECIFICATION Case 42 MM Dial Traditional Floral Pattern with Red Date marker Back Exhibition Case Back Thickness 13.8 mm Crystal Front and Back Sapphire Movement Citizen Miyota 8215 Automatic Strap 20mm Leather Strap Coating AR Coating Water Resistance 5 ATM Case Material CNC Cut Metal case

specsRaw.Dial: Traditional Floral Pattern with Red Date marker

watches.name: THE ONE
watches.description: In a tribute to India’s rich colonial past and timeless craftsmanship, Jaipur Watch Company proudly unveils its latest creation — “ The One” Automatic Watch , a fusion of legacy and modern precision. At the heart of this timepiece lies an authentic Quarter Anna coin from 1938–1940 extremely limited period currency , carefully embedded into the dial, transforming each watch into a wearable relic of history. With its vintage aura and historic significance, it offers collectors and enthusiasts alike a chance to own a slice of India’s heritage. Elegantly designed, the watch is available in Royal Green and Classic Black dials, adorned with Devanagari numerals and vintage-style hands that echo a bygone era. The 39mm stainless steel case is paired with your choice of India's first adjustable mesh bracelet or a leather strap , delivering both timeless style and modern comfort. Crafted for durability and precision, the watch features sapphire crystal glass , a transparent peephole case back , and is powered by the Miyota 8215 automatic movement, offering a 42-hour power reserve — a reliable engine that ensures your timepiece keeps ticking with grace. SPECIFICATION Case 316L Grade Stainless Steel Dial Black Dial With Emperor King George Coin Size 39mm Thickness 15mm Crystal Sapphire Movement Miyota 8215 Automatic Strap 18mm adjustable Metal Bracelet Back Peep - Hole Water Resistant 5 ATM

The One Pice coin, with its iconic depiction of a galloping horse, symbolizes India's leap into independence and the dawn of a new era. It represents the strength, freedom, and progress that defined the nation during its early years of sovereignty. This historical coin, encased within the watch, serves as a poignant reminder of India's journey and its enduring legacy. The watch face is adorned with a never used before Opal stone and Aventurine Stone Dial and Black mother-of-pearl dial, adding an element of elegance and sophistication. The luminous quality of the mother-of-pearl complements the vintage charm of the One Pice coin, creating a harmonious blend of history and artistry. The sleek, silver-tone case and black leather strap enhance its timeless appeal, making it a versatile accessory for any occasion. Crafted with meticulous attention to detail, the One Pice Heritage Watch is a tribute to the craftsmanship and heritage of Jaipur. Each timepiece is a reflection of the city's renowned artistry, blending traditional design with contemporary elegance. The watch not only honors India's past but also celebrates the skill and dedication of the artisans who bring this piece of history to life. Wearing the One Pice Heritage Watch is more than a fashion statement; it is a connection to India's rich heritage and a celebration of its journey towards freedom and progress. This watch is a perfect gift for history enthusiasts, collectors, and anyone who cherishes the legacy of India. With every glance at the time, one is reminded of the resilience and spirit that define the Indian identity. The Jaipur Watch Company invites you to own a piece of history with the One Pice Heritage Watch, a timeless treasure that embodies the essence of India's storied past and its vibrant present. watches.name: The Royal Baagh Hand Engraved Watch
watches.description: In every great civilization, the tiger (the Baagh) has stood as a guardian of the wild and a sovereign of the land. The Royal Baagh Collection channels this enduring symbol of strength into a timepiece that is as commanding as it is refined—built for those who carry a sense of purpose, presence, and pride. This collection is a tribute to legacy—an homage to the iconic Baagh timepiece that has become one of our most celebrated creations. Royal Baagh evolves that spirit, pushing the boundaries of craftsmanship and detail while honoring the soul of the original. Each case is CNC-carved individually, sculpted with singular focus to ensure every edge, curve, and engraving receives the care it deserves. The case and lugs are enveloped in exquisite macro 3D reliefs—a prowling Baagh brought to life, surrounded by intricate floral motifs inspired by India’s royal courts and classical design. Watch edorened with hand engraved dial; every single piece is unique. Shielded by sapphire crystal, the Royal Baagh is built to endure—just like the legacy it celebrates. watches.name: The Majestic Elephant Ring Watch
watches.description: Jaipur Watch Company presents a horological masterpiece that transcends conventional timekeeping — a jewel that embodies heritage, artistry, and innovation. Drawing inspiration from Rajasthan’s iconic elephant motifs in traditional jewellery, this creation reimagines cultural legacy in the form of an extraordinary timepiece. Handcrafted with precision using age-old jewellery-making techniques, it showcases vibrant green enamel artistry paired with the timeless brilliance of 2.64 carats of fine diamonds, highlighted by two magnificent 0.50-carat Polki, all set in 18-carat gold. At its centre lies an intricately designed elephant, beneath which rests a mother-of-pearl dial, revealed through a bespoke lid-opening mechanism. Ingeniously versatile, this masterpiece transforms seamlessly between a ring and a watch — uniting elegance with ingenuity. A true tribute to Rajasthan’s craftsmanship, this creation reflects Jaipur Watch Company enduring philosophy: reviving heritage through timeless innovation NOTE: The Order will be processed within 45 days of ordering the watch. watches.name: FILIGREE IV BLACK
watches.description: Filigree Technique Jaipur Watch Company proudly introduces the Filigree IV Wristwear, a new chapter in its celebrated Filigree collection. Rooted in timeless artistry, this edition continues to honor the meticulous jewelry-making technique of filigree, where skilled artisans delicately twist and solder fine threads of precious metal into elegant, lacy motifs. Traditionally used to embellish fine jewelry and royal treasures, this intricate craft finds new expression in watchmaking, creating a dial that is both artistic and historically significant. At its heart lies an authentic 2 Naya Paisa coin, minted between 1957–1963, symbolizing India’s post-independence era. The coin’s heritage, combined with the filigree-inspired pattern, transforms the watch into a wearable piece of history. Following the overwhelming success and complete sell-out of the original Filigree Wristwear, the Filigree IV brings refined updates in color, dimensions, and movement while preserving the soul of the collection. watches.name: THE ETERNAL RED OPAL WRISTWEAR
watches.description: The Jaipur Watch Company proudly presents the One Pice Heritage Watch, a timepiece that not only tells time but also tells a story of India's rich history. This exquisite watch features a genuine One Pice coin from 1950-55, the first coin minted in independent India, seamlessly integrated into its design. The One Pice coin, with its iconic depiction of a galloping horse, symbolizes India's leap into independence and the dawn of a new era. It represents the strength, freedom, and progress that defined the nation during its early years of sovereignty. This historical coin, encased within the watch, serves as a poignant reminder of India's journey and its enduring legacy. The watch face is adorned with a never used before Opal stone and Aventurine Stone Dial and Black mother-of-pearl dial, adding an element of elegance and sophistication. The luminous quality of the mother-of-pearl complements the vintage charm of the One Pice coin, creating a harmonious blend of history and artistry. The sleek, silver-tone case and black leather strap enhance its timeless appeal, making it a versatile accessory for any occasion. Crafted with meticulous attention to detail, the One Pice Heritage Watch is a tribute to the craftsmanship and heritage of Jaipur. Each timepiece is a reflection of the city's renowned artistry, blending traditional design with contemporary elegance. The watch not only honors India's past but also celebrates the skill and dedication of the artisans who bring this piece of history to life. Wearing the One Pice Heritage Watch is more than a fashion statement; it is a connection to India's rich heritage and a celebration of its journey towards freedom and progress. This watch is a perfect gift for history enthusiasts, collectors, and anyone who cherishes the legacy of India. With every glance at the time, one is reminded of the resilience and spirit that define the Indian identity. The Jaipur Watch Company invites you to own a piece of history with the One Pice Heritage Watch, a timeless treasure that embodies the essence of India's storied past and its vibrant present. (Note: The Coin on the dial can be of any year between 1950-1955) SPECIFICATION Case 316 L Grade Stainless Steel Dial Opal Size 42mm Thickness 14mm Crystal Sapphire Movement TMI NH35A Automatic Strap 20mm Leather strap

watches.name: THE PICE HERITAGE
watches.description: The Pice Heritage Watch by Jaipur Watch Company is a distinctive luxury timepiece that blends history, craftsmanship, and modern design. At its core, it features a genuine ‘One-Pice coin (1950–1955)’, seated on a dial inspired by India's traditional hand-hammered brass craft, offering a unique and artistic texture. The dial also showcases Devanagari script numerals, adding an extra layer of historical and cultural significance to the timepiece. Designed to cater to both men and women, the 40mm case size ensures the watch appeals to a wide audience. The inclusion of movable lugs enhances comfort and adaptability, allowing the watch to fit a variety of wrist sizes while adding a premium vintage touch to its overall look. This thoughtful blend of modern functionality and classic design elements reflects Jaipur Watch Company’s commitment to creating versatile yet luxurious timepieces that celebrate Indian tradition. Crafted from premium materials like stainless steel and Mineral glass, The Pice Heritage Coin Watch offers durability and elegance. Each timepiece not only serves as a functional watch but also as a wearable piece of history and art. (Note: The Coin on the dial can be of any year between 1950-1955) SPECIFICATION Case OD 40 mm Crystal Mineral Dial One Pice (1950 -1955), Black Hammered Texture, Devanagari Numerals Movement Miyota 2033 Quartz Strap 20mm Genuine Leather

watches.name: BLUE PENNY STAMP GOLD WATCH
watches.description: The Two Pence Blue, Great Britain issued the world’s first postage stamp - The Penny Black - on May 6, 1840. Two days Later, on May 8, The Two Pence / Penny Blue was first issued in the English post office. It was the world’s second Postage Stamp. The Two Pence Blue stamp paid the postage for letters weighing between one - half and one ounce. It features a design identical to that of the Penny Black, other than the inscription “ Two Pence “. In addition, it was printed in blue instead of black. The Two Pence Blue was engraved by Charles and Frederick Heath and printed by Perkins, Bacon & Petch ( Later Perkins, Bacon & Company ). The portrait of Queen Victoria was based on medal engraved by English coin designer William Wyon when Victoria was a 15 year old princess. Victoria ascended the throne in 1837 at the age of 18. Each stamp sheet contained 240 stamps ( 20 rows of 12 stamps ), and the letters in the bottom left right corners identify each stamp’s unique position on the sheet. The Stamps were issued without perforations, so they were cut from the sheet with scissors or knife at the post office. The original Two Pence Blue stamp was replaced with a modified design in March 1841. Due to the short issue period and infrequent postal use, the 1840 - 1841 Two Pence Blue is one of the scarcest Stamps in the world. This Two Pence Blue is a genuine example of the world’s second postage stamp. It was officially postmarked during postal use, more than 165 years ago. SPECIFICATION Case 316 L Grade Stainless Steel Dial Blue Penny Stamp Denomination 2 Pence Size 34 X 30.2 MM Thickness 7 MM Crystal Sapphire Movement Ronda 1062 Quartz Strap Leather

watches.name: QUEEN VICTORIA STAMP WATCH
watches.description: The Penny Black, introduced in the United Kingdom on May 1, 1840, is recognized as the world's first adhesive postage stamp. It was a key part of Sir Rowland Hill's postal reforms aimed at simplifying and reducing the cost of sending mail, shifting the burden of payment from the recipient to the sender with a uniform postage rate of one penny. Featuring a profile of Queen Victoria and printed in black, the stamp included security features like an intricate background design and identifying letters to prevent forgery. Though it was in use for less than a year, being replaced by the Penny Red in 1841 due to issues with visibility of cancellation marks, the Penny Black made a significant impact on the postal system. Today, the Penny Black is a highly valued collector's item due to its historical significance. While not the rarest stamp, its pioneering role in postal history makes it particularly prized among philatelists. Its value can vary based on condition, with mint condition stamps and those with clear cancellation marks or on original covers being especially sought after. The Penny Black set the standard for postage stamps worldwide and continues to be celebrated through various commemorations and reproductions, marking its lasting legacy in both philately and communication history. SPECIFICATION Case 316 L Grade Stainless Steel Dial Queen Victoria Stamp Denomination 3 Pies Size 34 X 30.2 MM Thickness 7 MM Crystal Sapphire Movement Ronda 1062 Quartz Strap Leather

watches.name: DIAMOND STUDDED ETERNAL WATCH
watches.description: The Jaipur Watch Company proudly presents the Eternal Watch, a timepiece that not only tells time but also tells a story of India's rich history. This exquisite watch features a genuine One Pice coin from 1950-55, the first coin minted in independent India, seamlessly integrated into its design. The One Pice coin, with its iconic depiction of a galloping horse, symbolizes India's leap into independence and the dawn of a new era. It represents the strength, freedom, and progress that defined the nation during its early years of sovereignty. This historical coin, encased within the watch, serves as a poignant reminder of India's journey and its enduring legacy. The watch face is adorned with a mother-of-pearl dial, adding an element of elegance and sophistication. The luminous quality of the mother-of-pearl complements the vintage charm of the One Pice coin, creating a harmonious blend of history and artistry. The sleek, silver-tone case and black leather strap enhance its timeless appeal, making it a versatile accessory for any occasion. Crafted with meticulous attention to detail, the Eternal Watch is a tribute to the craftsmanship and heritage of Jaipur. Each timepiece is a reflection of the city's renowned artistry, blending traditional design with contemporary elegance. The watch not only honors India's past but also celebrates the skill and dedication of the artisans who bring this piece of history to life. Wearing the Eternal Watch is more than a fashion statement; it is a connection to India's rich heritage and a celebration of its journey towards freedom and progress. This watch is a perfect gift for history enthusiasts, collectors, and anyone who cherishes the legacy of India. With every glance at the time, one is reminded of the resilience and spirit that define the Indian identity. The Jaipur Watch Company invites you to own a piece of history with the Eternal Watch, a timeless treasure that embodies the essence of India's storied past and its vibrant present. watches.description: The Penny Black, introduced in the United Kingdom on May 1, 1840, is recognized as the world's first adhesive postage stamp. It was a key part of Sir Rowland Hill's postal reforms aimed at simplifying and reducing the cost of sending mail, shifting the burden of payment from the recipient to the sender with a uniform postage rate of one penny. Featuring a profile of Queen Victoria and printed in black, the stamp included security features like an intricate background design and identifying letters to prevent forgery. Though it was in use for less than a year, being replaced by the Penny Red in 1841 due to issues with visibility of cancellation marks, the Penny Black made a significant impact on the postal system. Today, the Penny Black is a highly valued collector's item due to its historical significance. While not the rarest stamp, its pioneering role in postal history makes it particularly prized among philatelists. Its value can vary based on condition, with mint condition stamps and those with clear cancellation marks or on original covers being especially sought after. The Penny Black set the standard for postage stamps worldwide and continues to be celebrated through various commemorations and reproductions, marking its lasting legacy in both philately and communication history. watches.name: BLUE PENNY STAMP WATCH
watches.description: The Two Pence Blue, Great Britain issued the world’s first postage stamp - The Penny Black - on May 6, 1840. Two days Later, on May 8, The Two Pence / Penny Blue was first issued in the English post office. It was the world’s second Postage Stamp. The Two Pence Blue stamp paid the postage for letters weighing between one - half and one ounce. It features a design identical to that of the Penny Black, other than the inscription “ Two Pence “. In addition, it was printed in blue instead of black. The Two Pence Blue was engraved by Charles and Frederick Heath and printed by Perkins, Bacon & Petch ( Later Perkins, Bacon & Company ). The portrait of Queen Victoria was based on medal engraved by English coin designer William Wyon when Victoria was a 15 year old princess. Victoria ascended the throne in 1837 at the age of 18. Each stamp sheet contained 240 stamps ( 20 rows of 12 stamps ), and the letters in the bottom left right corners identify each stamp’s unique position on the sheet. The Stamps were issued without perforations, so they were cut from the sheet with scissors or knife at the post office. The original Two Pence Blue stamp was replaced with a modified design in March 1841. Due to the short issue period and infrequent postal use, the 1840 - 1841 Two Pence Blue is one of the scarcest Stamps in the world. This Two Pence Blue is a genuine example of the world’s second postage stamp. It was officially postmarked during postal use, more than 165 years ago. SPECIFICATION Case 316 L Grade Stainless Steel Dial Blue PennyStamp Denomination 2 Pence Size 34 X 30.2 MM Thickness 7 MM Crystal Sapphire Movement Ronda 1062 Quartz Strap Leather

watches.name: THE ETERNAL WATCH
watches.description: The Jaipur Watch Company proudly presents the Eternal Watch, a timepiece that not only tells time but also tells a story of India's rich history. This exquisite watch features a genuine One Pice coin from 1950-55, the first coin minted in independent India, seamlessly integrated into its design. The One Pice coin, with its iconic depiction of a galloping horse, symbolizes India's leap into independence and the dawn of a new era. It represents the strength, freedom, and progress that defined the nation during its early years of sovereignty. This historical coin, encased within the watch, serves as a poignant reminder of India's journey and its enduring legacy. The watch face is adorned with a mother-of-pearl dial, adding an element of elegance and sophistication. The luminous quality of the mother-of-pearl complements the vintage charm of the One Pice coin, creating a harmonious blend of history and artistry. The sleek, silver-tone case and black leather strap enhance its timeless appeal, making it a versatile accessory for any occasion. Crafted with meticulous attention to detail, the Eternal Watch is a tribute to the craftsmanship and heritage of Jaipur. Each timepiece is a reflection of the city's renowned artistry, blending traditional design with contemporary elegance. The watch not only honors India's past but also celebrates the skill and dedication of the artisans who bring this piece of history to life. Wearing the Eternal Watch is more than a fashion statement; it is a connection to India's rich heritage and a celebration of its journey towards freedom and progress. This watch is a perfect gift for history enthusiasts, collectors, and anyone who cherishes the legacy of India. With every glance at the time, one is reminded of the resilience and spirit that define the Indian identity. The Jaipur Watch Company invites you to own a piece of history with the Eternal Watch, a timeless treasure that embodies the essence of India's storied past and its vibrant present. (Note: The Coin on the dial can be of any year between 1950-1955) SPECIFICATION Case 316 L Grade Stainless Steel Dial White MOP Size 42mm Thickness 14mm Crystal Sapphire Movement TMI NH35A Automatic Strap 20mm Leather strap

watches.name: BAAGH II STEEL
watches.description: Introducing The Baagh II: an exquisite addition to our esteemed Baagh Collection, renowned for its timeless elegance and historical significance. Building upon the legacy of its predecessor, The Baagh II proudly features the distinctive Quarter Rupee Bagh Coin, a symbol of heritage and tradition. Drawing inspiration from the opulent Art Deco era, the design of The Baagh II intricately showcases a mesmerizing Mosaic enameled dial, available in three captivating color variations. The offset watch face ingeniously highlights the singular presentation of the coin, adding a touch of sophistication to its aesthetic appeal. At the heart of this masterpiece lies a premium Small Automatic Miyota Movement, renowned for its precision and reliability, offering a remarkable 42 hours of power reserve. The introduction of the unique Tonneau case marks a significant milestone in Jaipur Watch Company's esteemed collection. Crafted with meticulous attention to detail, the Tonneau Case serves as a captivating showcase for both the exquisite coin and the beautifully enameled dial. Its distinctive stepped rails gracefully complement the tonneau case, creating an interplay of light and shadow that ensures The Baagh II stands out effortlessly in any setting, making it a true statement piece for the discerning connoisseur. This stainless steel watch has been created by using a particular Quarter Rupee Coin from the year 1947, bearing a Tiger on the face. The Walking tiger (Baagh in Hindi) has close resemblance with the Make In India Logo. This Quarter Rupee Coin holds its significance as it was the last coin minted under the British Rule. It was minted only in the years 1946 (second half) and 1947. Known for using coins in our timepieces, this time we decided to do something which as per our knowledge has not been done by another watch brand till date in the country and the chances of this being done anywhere globally also are unheard of, we decided to use a Real Paper Postal Stamp dating between the period 1937 - 1947. This timepiece will be a new release to mark Jaipur Watch Company. To emblazon a Stamp on a timepiece is to offer the most fitting eulogy to its glorious past, preserving it, forever. This is a limited watch with the dial being a real postal Stamp dating back to the period 1937-47. The value of the stamp starts from 3 Pies which is the lowest denomination of the stamp series which was followed by 9 Pies, 1⁄2 Anna and so on till 12 Anna. SPECIFICATION Case 316 L Grade Stainless Steel Dial King George VI Stamp, Red Denomination 1 Anna Size 34 X 30.2 MM Thickness 7 MM Crystal Sapphire Movement Ronda 1062 Quartz Strap Metal Bracelet

watches.name: Lord Ram Panchayatan Automatic Watch Steel
watches.description: Ram became the king of Ayodhya after completing fourteen years life of banishment, imposed by his step mother Kaikeyi, along with wife Sita and brother Lakshman. Bharat was appointed the crown prince, Lakshman commander-in-chief and Shatrughana became the Finance Minister of Ayodhya. Lord Ram was most efficient King of Ayodhya with no fear of enemies or thieves. He used to travel entire country in disguise to inquire about the welfare, displeasure of his people. The country overflowed with all prosperity. Dispensation of justice was impartially rendered by Ram. In this oleograph, Ram is seated on the throne with Sita on His left thigh. watches.name: Ram Panchayatan Desk Timepiece
watches.description: This exquisite table clock is a celebration of the fusion between timeless art and functional decor. Crafted with precision, the clock showcases the iconic "Ram Panchayat" - a reverent assembly led by Lord Ram, a central figure in Indian mythology and the epic Ramayana. The artwork, originally by the celebrated Indian artist Raja Ravi Varma, is known for bringing classic Indian epics to life. Varma's press, which was responsible for printing his famed lithographs, allowed his art to adorn the homes of art aficionados, and this clock continues that legacy. The brass structure of the clock, with its vintage finish, evokes a sense of nostalgia, harkening back to the elegance of the late 19th and early 20th centuries when Ravi Varma's works were in high demand. The circular frame, supported by a sturdy base, allows the intricate painting to be viewed from all angles, making it a focal point of any room. This table clock is not only a functional timepiece but also a slice of cultural heritage, perfect for those who appreciate the rich tapestry of Indian art history. It's an ideal piece for collectors, enthusiasts of Indian art, or anyone looking to infuse their space with the grace and storytelling of Raja Ravi Varma's work. SPECIFICATION Material Brass Dial Paper Dial Movement Quartz Crystal Mineral
